title: Quaint French Tart
description: A delightful French-inspired tart filled with a delicious goat cheese mixture, perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry and place on a baking sheet.
In a mixing bowl, combine goat cheese, crème fraîche, thyme, and salt. Mix until smooth.
Spread the goat cheese mixture evenly over the puff pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges with egg and sprinkle with honey (if using).
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
